error_type: total marginalized 1sigma including model, cosmic variance and observation uncertainties
covariance_status: not recovered from primaryTable3; cannot claim independent redshift bins
likelihood_status: comparison/marginal sensitivity data; any independent split-normal pseudo-likelihood is explicit approximation, not published joint likelihood
averaging: spatially averaged UVB inferred by forward modeling fluctuating Lyalpha optical-depth distribution
measures_correlated: Gamma, mean free path, neutral fraction and emissivity derived jointly; do not multiply their separate marginals as independent likelihoods
table_identity: numeric content transcription from primary Table3
